job.description: N18, the loop with the judge's data and weighting held fixed: the real run on seeds 4101-4105. Trains rw-cloop, rw-ctwin, rw-j20, rw-peer, rw-j025, rw-j0125 and rw-nfree at full length (35 runs). Re-measures N17's rw-peer, rw-j10 and rw-j05 (from the n17_loop Drive folder), N13's n80-rw, N16's rw-oracle, N12's sub20 and clean, and N14's sub10, sub05, sub025 and sub0125 of each seed (from n13_signal, n16_judge, n12_bottleneck and n14_dose) on the held-out tail's windows 1-512, and compares rw-peer with N17's saved models. It first runs the setup checks; if any fails, it stops before training. NEEDS AN A100: before Run all, choose Runtime > Change runtime type > A100 GPU. On any other GPU it stops before training. About 100 minutes. Resumable: if a session ends, choose Run all again and finished work is skipped.
